houses.name: House Valerius

houses.name: House Vance

timeline.title: Charter of Aurelia Sector
timeline.description: Empress Cassandria Aurelius establishes the Aurelia Imperial Hegemony, distributing planetary fiefdoms to Great Houses.

timeline.title: The Iron War Schism
timeline.description: House Valerius launches an armed trade rebellion against imperial tariffs, ending with the Treaty of Iron Forge.

timeline.title: Chartering of Vanguard Dynamics
timeline.description: Vanguard Dynamics is established as an official corporate security contractor under House Valerius charter.

timeline.title: Quantum Neural Uplink Breakthrough
timeline.description: Cygnus Neural Systems unveils the first fully autonomous AI command node at Cygnus Prime Station.

timeline.title: Bio-Strain Contamination Incident
timeline.description: An experimental gene-agent breaks containment in an Aetheric BioTech lab, requiring orbital quarantine by House Vance.

timeline.title: The Aurelia-Prime Target Confusion Incident
timeline.description: Ambiguous order coordinates sent to Dreadnought Aurelia-Prime cause accidental targeting of Station Aurelia-Prime.

timeline.title: Battle of the Twin Vanguards
timeline.description: Vanguard Dynamics strike cruiser Vanguard accidentally engages House Valerius transport Vanguard due to matching IFF callsigns.

timeline.title: The Tri-House Cyber Accord
timeline.description: Houses Aurelius, Valerius, and Vance sign a non-aggression neural pact, integrating security intelligence networks.
